origin: Short for floating action button, a name Google gave it when it announced Material Design in 2014. It means the main action button floating above the screen.
whenToUse: The screen has one main action, such as composing an email or a post.
People need to press it right away even while browsing a long list.
whenNotToUse: There are several actions (use a toolbar or menu).
Wide desktop screens (a header button is enough).

alternatives.name: Button
alternatives.reason: A main button fixed within the screen.

accessibility: Keep the same name with aria-label even when only the icon remains.
Add bottom padding so the last list item isn't hidden under the button.
The keyboard focus ring stays visible over the shadow.
The shrinking transition responds only to scroll direction, so it doesn't flicker.
